parameters.name: AccountDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the account. The description must meet the following requirements:

*   The description must start with a letter.
*   The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
*   The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
*   The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the database account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-account-description --db-cluster-id am-bp1xxxxxxxx47 --account-name testacc --account-description AccDesc --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb ModifyAccountDescription --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription AccDesc --DBClusterId 'am-bp1xxxxxxxx47' --AccountName testacc
